yid du 'ong ba padma pa ti'i man ngag rdzogs so'i mtha' can | khol po pa ti'i man ngag mgor 'ong nges pa zhes pa dang*/ pra yatstsha dzdza zhes brjod kyi mtha' can/ sman chen po'i bcud len mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam gyi yan lag sman chen po'i bcud len ni zhes pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag go i thi'i mtha' can/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por gong sgrub thabs gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa man chad nas 'di bar la jo bo nā ro ta pa'i gsung ngag de'i man ngag thor bu rnams tshang ma zhes pa tsam las so sor ma gsungs kyang thams cad bsdus nas gsungs pa yin no/ /dbang gi las kyi man ngag mgor/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo | | bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes pa nas zin bris chig brgyud du byas pa i thi'i mtha' can/ gsang ba'i gnad lnga zhal shes dang bcas pa'i tho yig sogs man ngag 'thor bu shin tu gsang ba gal che i thi'i mtha' can te 'di rnams rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa yin yang phag mo skor gsum gyi man ngag 'di rnams phyogs gcig tu bya ba'i phyir/ snga ma rnams kyis 'dir bris pa ltar bzhag go /rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /jo bo na ro ta pas gzhan la ma gnang ba'i zhes yod pa/ nges brjod bla ma'i 'phrul 'khor bri bsgoms gyi man ngag mgor/ rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang mtshungs rje btsun bla chen dang*/ /zhes yod pa/ gsan yig rgya mtshor 'di la 'chi med rdo rje lha mo'i sgrub thabs kyang zer gsung*/ kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud kyi bshad thabs kyi man ngag bsdus don bcas mgor/ bla ma rje btsun rin chen lta bu dang*/ /zhes yod pa/ kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud kyi gsal byed mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /spang bya'i dri ma ma lus kun spangs shing*/

/zhes yod pa/ ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs mgor | bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs la don gnyis te zhes yod pa/ tshogs bdag dmar po'i sgrub thabs sbyin sreg zhal gdams dang bcas pa'i mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo | | gdams pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u zhes yod pa/ dgra nag gi sgrub thabs mgor | dri med rgyud don ston mdzad bla ma dang*/ /zhes yod pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa mgor/ mi'u thung nag po sprin lta'i mdog /ces pa dang*/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa i thi'i mtha' can/ yang de la bstod pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la bstod pa/ 'phags pa mjam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos po kun gyi de nyid chos dbyings kun rtog bral | | zhes yod pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na bstod pa gnyis yod med kyi nges pa ma mdzad kyang gsan yig rgya mtsho dang*/ dbang gi rgyal po gnyis ka nas gnyis kyi gsal kha byung bas gong mar mdzad byang med pa sogs la the tshom ma za zhig phyi ma 'di rtse mo'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa la/ slar yang rje btsun gyis kha skong mdzad pa gzhung tshig gis gsal lo/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs las sbyor dang bcas pa'i mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rjes su 'brang ba/ zhes yod pa/ sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro'i sgrub thabs dang bstod pa 'don thabs las kha tshar dang bcas pa mgor/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun sgrol ma zhi khro gnyis/ /zhes yod pa/ sgrol ma spyi'i sgrub thabs mgor/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs dang sgrol ma la/ /zhes pa dang*/ spyi'i sgrub thabs kyi brjed byang i thi'i mtha' can/ so so'i sgrub thabs mgor/ yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo/

/ spy-i'i sgrub thabs bzhin bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs nas sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi dus kyi rnal 'byor/ zhes yod pa dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i brjed byang i thi'i mtha' can/ bstod pa 'don thabs kyi brjed byang mgor/ ooṃ swasti/ thun mtshams su phyag 'tshal nyer gcig pa 'don par 'dod pas/ zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por gong sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro nas 'di'i bar la sgrol ma'i chos skor gsungs pa tsam las ming so sor ma smos kyang yi ge nyung ba'i phyir du phyogs gcig bsdus nas gsungs pa yin pas lung bzhugs pa yin no/ /sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs kyi ṭī ka dang sa bcad mgor/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por bla ma la btud nas/ /zhes yod pa dang/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i man ngag rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ de'i las tshogs kyi bsdus don mgor/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig ces yod pa/ dbang bskur ba'i sa bcad/ le'u bcu pa dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dbang gi cho ga la gnyis te/ zhes pa dang*/ sa bcad do'i mtha' can/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga mgor/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po mtshan nyid lnga dang ldan pa'i bla ma zhes pa dang*/ dbang gi cho ga'i tho tsam phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te bstan pa dbang gi mngon rtogs 'di sa skya pa chen pos mdzad do | | dgu pa dbang bskur ba'i man ngag go'i mtha' can/ sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal sa skya'i dgon pa nas rigs dang yon tan phun sum tshogs pa zhes dang bshad na mtha' yas par 'gyur mod/ bod skad thad sor bsgyur mi btub lags/ mchan med pa rnams kyi thad sor de skad gsung bar zhu'i mtha' can/ 'di mchims chos seng gi don du mdzad pa yin no/ /phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sa bcad na mo bungnghā ya

| bstod pa la don gnyis te/ zhes yod pa/ bstod pa'i rnam bshad gsal ba'i 'od zer mgor/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal sgrol ma ni zhes yod pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag na 'di rje btsun gyis sgrol bstod la mchan mdzad pa de gang zag rjes ma zhig gis dkyus su bcug pa snang ngo gsungs pa de shin tu 'brel che ste mchan dkyus su song tshe tshig gi khrigs gong 'og cung zad 'khrugs pa ltar snang ngo*/ /sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa las tshogs dang bcas pa'i mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid shes rab dngos/ /zhes yod pa/ gsol 'debs maṇḍal bzhi pa/ na mo gu ra we/ srod dang tho rangs langs par byas nas/ /zhes yod pa/ rje btsun pa'i rnam thar mnal lam khams pa sbal ston gyis bris pa mgor/ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas zhes pa dang*/ rje btsun chen po'i mnal lam bris pa'o'i mtha' can/ rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag na 'di khams pa sbal ston gyis bris pa yin na'ang*/ rje btsun gyi gsung ji lta ba bzhin yin pas 'dir bzhag pa yin gsungs | gsang sngags nang gi lhung bzed brtag pa mgor/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin po che'i gzhal yas khang brtag pa la zhes yod pa/ 'di yang rje btsun gyi gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin du sna ro'i bandes bris pa yin no

| | ga ring rgyal po la rtsis bsdur du btang ba'i yi ge mgor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i brgyud pa ni/ zhes yod pa/ ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi spyi don mgor/ sangs rgyas kun dngos ngo bo nyid | | ces yod pa/ sbyong rgyud kyi sa bcad mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud 'di la don bzhi ste/ zhes pa dang*/ 'di ni dpal ldan sa skyar bris kyi mtha' can/ yo ga rdo rje 'byung ba'i yig sna mgor/ chos rnams rang bzhin med gzigs kyang*/ /zhes pa can/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i gzhung so so'i yig sna mgor/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten la zhes pa can/ sgrub thabs kun gyi ṭīka chung re dang bsdus don bcas 'di rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag tu 'dir bzhag 'dug dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i tho yig mun sel sgron me'i gzhug na sa skya pa chen pos mdzad par bzhed 'dug sgrub thabs spyi'i rnam gzhag mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyir 'khor ba la thog ma med ces pa dang sgrub thabs kyi gtad rgya'o i thi'i mtha' can/ rdo rje phur pa'i mngon rtogs dang las byang*/ yang de'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma/ gsan yig rgya mtshor phur pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma/ phur pa'i tho yig rgyun gyi man ngag la sogs pa'i las kha tshar ba 'ga' gsung*/ gong gi tshig lhug pa 'di rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa yin na'ang 'dir glegs bam kha langs pa'i ched du phur pa'i sgrub skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te bris pa rnams bzhugs so// //glegs bam bzhi pa ( ta ) pa la kun rig gi cho ga gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer mgor/ rgyud don gsal bar ston mdzad bla ma dang*/ /zhes yod pa/ de'i cho ga bsdus pa gzhan phan nyer mkho mgor | bcom ldan 'das dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/

/thog mar bdag gi rnal 'byor bstan pa ni | | zhes yod pa/ gsan yig rgya mtshor ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyong ba/ kun rig nas 'byung ba'i phyag len/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gsungs pa de thams cad kyang 'dir 'dus so/ /arga'i cho ga mgor/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten gsar pa la zhes yod pa/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga don gsal mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la spyi bos gus par phyag 'tshal lo | | gang zhig spros pa kun las rnam grol yang*/ /zhes yod pa/ bya spyod rigs gsum spyi'i rigs kyi cho ga mgor/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po gsung gi mnga' bdag 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur bar 'dod na zhes yod pa | 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel man ngag don gsal mgor/ rin chen lta bu'i bla ma mchog rnams dang*/ /zhes yod pa/ mi g.yo ba'i bstod pa rim pa gsum pa 'thad par ldan pa mgor/ dad pas bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes yod pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa rgyud gsum 'khor lo mgor/ mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ / zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma mgor/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang sku gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang zhes yod pa/ 'di rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag na sngon gyi dpe rnying 'ga' la rtse mos mdzad zer ba 'dug pa de dag pa yin no gsung*/ mtshan brjod 'don thabs mgor bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo | | mtshan yang dag par brjod pa 'don pa'i gdams ngag la gsum zhes yod pa/ a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i sgrub thabs the tshom can du bzhed pa mgor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing zhes pa dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal mthong shog gi mtha' can/

'di ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag tu sing ha shrī zer ba zhig gis byas pa snang gsung*/ rje btsun 'phags pa a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dbang gi cho ga ye shes snang ba'i sgron ma mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ don yod zhags pa'i cho ga lag tu blang ba'i rim pa mgor na mo buddhā ya/ de nyid don ston bla ma dang*/ /zhes yod pa/ de'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga mgor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /maṇḍal bya ba ni dri zhim po'i chus byugs la zhes pa dang me tog maṇḍal gyi dbus su spungs la bzhag go i thi'i mtha' can/ lha lnga'i bstod pa mgor/ bde gshegs kun las thugs rje mchog gyur pa/ /zhes pa dang*/ thugs rje'i sgo nas bstod pa dha byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa'o'i mtha' can/ srung 'khor bri tshul tshan pa gnyis mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di'i srung ba'i 'khor lo la don lnga ste zhes pa dang spyi dang mthun par gda'o'i mtha' can/ lag na rdo rje don kun grub pa'i gzungs kyi lag tu blang ba'i rim pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang dpal ldan bla chen gyi/ /zhes yod pa/ rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud kyi ṭī ka mgor/ don dam ston byed nus pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /zhes yod gos sngon can yin pa/ de'i sa bcad mgor dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo 'di la gnyis te zhes pa dang phan yon bstan pa'o'i mtha' can 'di gnyis la dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na the tshom can du bzhed yod do/ /dpung bzang gi mdo 'grel mgor dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i mdo sde 'di la zhes yod pa/ bar 'dir gsan yig dbang gi rgyal po sogs su mkha' lding gi man ngag gsungs kyang dpe rnams na yod pa ni gong sa chen gy-i skabs na yod pa dang zhu dag pher ba yod pas logs pa ma bris so/

/mi g.yo ba gsang ba chen po'i rgyud kyi man ngag mgor/ bgegs rnams 'joms mdzad dngos grub kun stsol ba | | zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por rtog pa dang po'i rnam 'grel gsungs pa 'di yin no/ /gtor chen don lnga ma mgor/ bla ma dang ni rkang gnyis gtso/ /zhes yod pa 'di rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag dang dkon mchog lhun grub gsan yig gnyis ka na rtse mo dang mi mthun pa'i shes byed kyis the tshom can du bzhed do/ /gtor ma brgya rtsa mgor/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yab/ /ces yod pa/ gsan yig rgya mtshor byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i zhes gsung*/ shākya rnams kyi rgyal rabs mgor/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug na gang gi gsung*/ /zhes yod pa/ bod kyi rgyal rabs mgor/ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ bod kyi rgyal rabs khri bdun ldeng gcig ces yod pa | rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo mgor thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo | | gang zhig gang la brten pa yis/ /zhes pa dang*/ legs pa'i gtam 'di shes par gyis kyi mtha' can/ dus tshod nges par bzung ba'i rtsis yig mgor mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lo gang la zla ba'i lhag ma yod pa zhes pa can/ gza' skar gyi 'phrod brtag mgor/ 'gro rnams dge dang mi dge bstan pa'i phyir/ /zhes yod pa/ zhe sa dgu phrugs kyi yi ge mgor/ 'gro mgon mnyam med ji snyed kun gzigs shing*/ /zhes pa dang rtse sprod rgod po gshog dang lnga'i mtha' can/ phyag rgya chen po gces btus mgor/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i man ngag phyag rgya chen po gnyis su med pa 'od gsal ba zhes bya ba yod pa sogs man ngag sum cu tham pa bla ma so so'i gdams ngag zab mo rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sbyin sreg mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdza gsar pa zhes yod pa/ las dang po pas nyams su blang ba'i rim pa chos spyod rin chen phreng ba mgor/

sku gsum rin chen de'i gsung dri ma med/ /ces yod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gsal bar ston pa shlo ka nyi shu pa'i bshad pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo dang*/ don ston don byed bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ / zhes yod pa/ spyod 'jug gi bsdus don mgor byang chub sems dpa' chen po gsung gi mnga' bdag ces bya ba yod pa/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa gnyis kyi dang po'i mgor bla ma sa skya pa chen po dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe zhes pa dang*/ nges shes khyad par can thob pa yin no sa māpta mi'i mtha' can/ 'di rje btsun gyis mdzad pa yin min brtag gnyis pa'i mgor/ bka' drin can gyi bla ma dang*/ /zhes yod pa/ ye shes rdo rje la gnang ba'i nyams dbyangs mgor na mo gu ra we/ dus gsum gyi bla ma thams cad la/ /zhes pa dang*/ bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog gi mtha' can/ khams bde dri ba'i nyams dbyangs mgor/ rje bla ma rnams kyi zhabs la 'dud/ /ces yod pa dang*/ e ma'o 'gro ba nyon re mongs/ /zhes pa'i mtha' can yang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /zhes pa'i man ngag ye shes rdo rje la gnang ba zhig dang*/ bdag dam pa'i lha chos byed pa la/ /zhes yod pa zhig gnas bstod kyi nyams dbyangs mgor dus gsum gyi bla ma dam pa zhes pa dang*/ glu mgur gyi rta la bskyon la longs | | i thi'i mtha' can/ rmi lam nyams len brgyad kyi nyams dbyangs mgor | grong dang gnas gzhi tshong dus gsum/ /zhes dang rmi lam nyams lan brgyad kyi dbyangs i thi'i mtha' can/ gnyen po bsten tshul gyi nyams dbyangs mgor | sems kyi rang so ma tshugs pas/ /zhes pa dang/ sems gnyen po bsten nas blangs pa yin gyi mtha' can/ sems 'dul tshul gyi nyams dbyangs mgor | mngon shes mig bral bdag ni las mang zhing*/ /zhes dang*/ ting 'dzin skyon can klong du 'gro mi bya'i mtha' can/ sgrub pa nyams su len tshul 'tshal ba brgyad yod pa/

gsang sngags nang g-i nyams len 'tshal ba bcu yod pa/ rang gis rang la bskul ba mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni nyon mongs gyis bsrung 'khor ba'i chos la dad/ /ces yod pa/ nyams dbyangs chen mo mgor na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ yon tan mtha' dag rgyud la sbyor mdzad pa'i | | zhes yod pa/ 'di rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag tu gling ras kyi zur za chen mo la bcos nas gzhan zhig gis byas pa yin nam zhes bdag gi bla ma gsung ngo zhes the tshom can du bzhed/ gso dpyad rgyal po'i dkor mdzod ces grags pa yan lag brgyad pa'i man ngag 'phags pa klu sgrub nas lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i bar rim par brgyud de/ bla ma mal lo tsā ba chen po la byung ba'i gdams ngag rnams rje sa chen/ rje btsun chen po/ bla ma dpal chen 'od po rnams kyis gdams ngag 'thor bu mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa dang po 'du ba spyi'i rnam gzhag nas mthar mgo bcos kyi bar gyi sman dpyad 'thor dpyad sogs rten 'brel gyis gdams ngag mang po rnams bzhugs so// // bzhi pa phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba chen po 'jam mgon sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhabs kyi gsung rab glegs bam dang po ( tha ) pa la thub pa'i dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ gzhung lugs legs par bshad pa mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ rol mo'i bstan bcos mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ blo gsal zhing don du gnyer ba'i skyes bu rnams la ji ltar dri ba'i tshul 'ga' zhig brtsam 'phro la gzhag pa mgor swasti dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas zhes pa dang*/ de ltar tshig gis nga la dris/ /zhes pa'i mtha' can/

mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ sgra la 'jug pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bden pa brnyes pa 'phags pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor/ /zhes yod pa/ smra sgo'i sa bcad mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra ba'i sgo la don gsum ste zhes yod pa/ byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa'i rnam bshad byis pa la phan pa mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang bstan bcos kyi ming de nyid yod pa/ yi ge'i sbyor ba mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing*/ /zhes yod pa/ rnam par gcad bya ji ltar sbyor tshul mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par gcad pa'i yi ge'i tshul cung zad brjod na zhes yod pa/ sngags kyi bklag thabs 'bras bu 'byung ba'i me tog mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig sngags log par bzlas gyur na/ /zhes yod pa/ sgra nye bar bsdus ba'i tshigs su bcad pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzlas brjod 'bri dang klog sogs la/ /zhes yod pa/ tshig gi gter mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi chun po zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje la bskul ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ bla ma rje btsun chen po'i rnam thar thun mong du grags pa mgor dpal chos kyi rje khams gsum gyi mgon po rje btsun sa skya pa chen po zhes yod pa/ nga brgyad ma rtsa 'grel mgor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgra pa nga yin zhes dang*/ bshad pa 'di la 'gal ba ci mchis pa/ / de ni mkhas pa'i tshogs la bzod par gsol gyi mtha' can rnams bzhugs so | | glegs bam gnyis pa ( da ) ba la tshad ma rigs pa'i gter rtsa ba dang 'grel pa gnyis/

dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga rgyas pa zhes yod pa/ de'i lung sbyor mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/ /zhes yod pa | gnyan phug chung bas mdzad pa'i lū hi pa'i 'bru 'bum 'di dpe snga ma rnams su sa chen gyi skabs na bris 'dug kyang 'dir glegs bam kha langs pa'i mchan du bris pa rnams bzhugs so// //glegs bam gsum pa ( na ) pa la bstan bcos sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la mchod pa brjod pa'i tshul gyis bstod pa mgor bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan blo gros nghīḥ las byung | | zhes yod pa can/ rje btsun chen po la bstod pa mgor/ srid pa'i 'khri shing dra ba dral mdzad cing*/ /zhes yod pa/ bi rū pa la bstod pa/ dad pa'i chu las tshig gi me tog 'di/ /zhes yod pa/ bde mchog brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi skye dang 'jig pa dag

/ces yod pa/ 'di'i bar skabs su kha skong shlo ka gnyis 'di bla ma phyi ma zhig gis mdzad par bsams nas yig chung byas bris yod/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la zhu ba'i 'phrin yig mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ skyes bu dam pa rnams la spring ba'i yi ge mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtse bas legs pa'i lam la sbyor/ /zhes yod pa/ lung rigs rnam dag dang mthun par 'chad dgos tshul mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas pa rnams las sde snod mang thos shing*/ /zhes yod pa/ rtog ldan rgyan po'i dris lan mgor rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul zhes yod pa/ rnel phu pa'i zhus lan mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa'i don du chos rnams kun/ /zhes pa dang mdor bsdus pa 'di legs par dgongs kyi mtha' can/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na 'di'i tshab tu rtogs ldan zhig gi dris lan gsungs pa 'di yin nam snyam nas bzhag pa las nges pa ma byung*/ zhang lo tsā ba la gdams pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu gsum pa mgor na maḥshrī mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rnam dag yid kyi chu gtsang las 'khrungs pa'i/ /zhes yod pa | bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams la spring ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ yang tshigs su bcad pa gong 'og gnyis smras pa zhes pa'i dbu can/ mi nyag gi rgyal khams su bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du gnyug mar gnas pa'i mkhan slob dge 'dun rnams la gnang ba'i yi ge mgor oṃ swasti siddhaṃ | me nyag gi rgyal khams na chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zhes yod pa/ nyi ma la spring ba mgor oṃ swasti siddhaṃ dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas zhes yod pa/ sho dgon pa 'gro mgon rin chen la spring ba mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bden par smra ba 'phags pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor//

zhes pa dang/ sho dgon dge 'dun rnams la spring ba mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams chu gter yon tan padmo'i tshal/ / zhes pa dang sde dgon yon mchod rnams kyi phyag tu phul gyi mtha' can/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo | | gang gis bskal pa du mar dka' spyad pa/ /zhes yod pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gu shi jo 'bum gyi don du mdzad pa mgor na mo gu ru bha drā ya spyir 'o skol rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa rnams zhes yod pa/ sgrub pa lung 'bogs mgor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub pa lung 'bogs pa'i zhes yod pa/ 'di la mdzad byang med pas sa paṇa yin min brtag sgrub pa lung sbyin mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi rdul dri ma med pa'i zhes yod pa/ rten 'brel lnga'i yi ge mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba lngas zhes yod pa/ lam sbas bshad mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa bdun pa yan chad ces pa dang*/ yi ge snga mar gsal bas 'dir ma bris so sa māpta'i mtha' can/ grub chen bcu dang phra mo brgyad kyi man ngag phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇḍal 'bul chog mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /maṇḍal 'bul bar 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ aṣta'i gzhi bshad snying po don gsal mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /anda rnyil btags zhes yod pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i lag tu blang pa'i rim pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa'i/ /zhes yod pa/ de la dgongs pa'i rdo rje gur gyi lung sbyor/ rnam 'joms rgyud kyi bshad pa bdud rtsi spel ba mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo | | bcu phrag bdun dang lnga phrag gcig /ces yod pa/

lam 'bras khrid kyi dkar chag na mo gu ra we/ mthu stobs dbang phyug gsung gi rgyun/ /zhes yod pa/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs kyi gsal byed mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo | | 'di'i brgyud pa ni zhes yod pa/ sgrol ma ljang gu'i mngon rtogs mgor rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun ma sgrub pa'i gang zag gis zhes yod pa/ kag chol gyi rjes gnang mgor na mo gu ru bhyaḥ rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /zhes yod pa/ ba ri ba'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa/ yang man ngag bsdus pa gcig dang bcas/ gza' thams cad kyi yum gyi mchod chog mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rigs drug gi mtshan don dang ye shes bsre ba'i bshad pa mgor tshangs pa la brahma zhes pa'i sgras zhes yod pa/ rigs kyi rab dbye'i bshad sbyar mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ sgra sgrub dum bu dgu pa ni dā na zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na zhes pa'i dbu can/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i bshad pa mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa | bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa dri ma med pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa mgor dri ma med pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa zhes yod pa/ zung 'jug gsal ba'i sa bcad mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i zung du 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhes yod pa/ bla ma la thun mong ba'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa mgor/ sku yi spyod pa rnam dag pa/ /zhes yod pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa mgor/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /ces yod pa/ bod yul la bsngags pa bstod tshig padmo'i phreng ba mgor/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mchog rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu yis/ /zhes yod pa/ shākya'i rgyal po la gsol ba bdebs pa tshigs su bcad pa bco lnga pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/

/gang zhig byang chub shing dbang drung du zhes yod pa/ bde bar gshegs pa khams gsum gyi mgon po la bstod pa tshigs bcad dgu pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo | | 'gro ba'i rtsa lag 'phags pa'i gtso dang lha dbang grub pa rig 'dzin gyis | | zhes yod pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu gcig pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten dbang phyug lha brgya'i gtsug gis zhabs mchod pa/ /zhes yod pa/ lha sa'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams la bsngags pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba kha ba kunda gangs ri'i mdog /ces yod pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa'i rnam bshad yi ge nyung ngu zhes bya ba mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros gtsug na yon tan nor bu'i 'od gsal zhing*/ /zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal gyi phyag mtshan ri mo'i yi ge mgor | sdom brtson dam pa dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho/ /zhes yod pa/ gangs ri'i khrod sgom chen rnams la spring ba mgor/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sgom chen mang yod de/ /zhes yod pa/ bu slob rnams la spring ba mgor bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por bod yul la bsngags pa zhes byung ba 'di min pa gzhan mi 'dug pas yig skyon yin nam snyam/ bod 'bangs spyi la gdams pa zhes dpe dngos la 'dug bka' gdams do kor ba'i zhu ba/ do kor ba'i zhus lan mgor bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /so sor thar pa 'dul ba bzhin/ /zhes yod pa/ mu stegs kyi ston pa 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa drug btul ba'i tshe sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad mgor oṃswasti siddhaṃ rgya mtsho'i gos can zhes pa'i dbu can/ yon tan sgrogs pa'i tshul la bstod pa mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/

/do shal phreng ba sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*/ /zhes yod pa/ ba gor zhes bya ba'i sgra las bstod pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ rta nag ri khud kyi rnga bo che la bsngags pa mgor/ lha dang lha dbang klu dbang mi yi gtso/ /zhes yod pa/ don mo ri pa'i gtsug lag khang du rje btsun gyis ri mo mdzad dus kyi tshigs bcad gnyis/ dpal gdong bzhi pa'i mgon po la bstod pa mgor na mo gu ra we dang*/ tshig de nyid yod pa/ theg chen lam gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo | | thub pas chos rnams gang gsungs pa/ /zhes yod pa/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyir dal 'byor gyi lus thob ces yod pa/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi sgom don mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i zhes yod pa/ 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag ngo mtshar can mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po dkon mchog gsum skyabs 'gro/ /zhes yod pa/ 'phags pa sdud pa sogs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo 'don thabs mgor rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo | | 'phags pa bsdus pa la sogs pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo 'don par 'dod na zhes bya ba yod pa/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don thabs na mo mañdzu shri ye/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don pa'i man ngag ni zhes yod pa/ spyod pa rnam dag gi tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa mgor spyod pa rnam par dag pa zhes yod pa/ sems kyi gnas lugs rnal du mtshon par byed pa'i man ngag tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ chag lo'i zhu ba mgor oṃ swasti siddhaṃ sdom pa gsum ldan rig pa'i gnas lnga thugs su chud pa zhes yod pa/ de'i zhus lan mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo | | bde byed chur nyal rang byung me tog mda'/

/zhes yod pa/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen la spring ba mgor oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ dpal sa skya'i dgon pa nas zhes yod pa/ bka' gdams pa nam mkha' 'bum gyi dris lan mgor oṃ swasti siddhaṃ | dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad cing thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa zhes yod pa/ ston pa blo gros rab gsal gyi dris lan mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ snye mo sgom chen gyi dris lan mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas dad pa dang 'dun pa dang ldan zhing zhes yod pa/ rnal 'byor pa phru ma'i dris lan mgor rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul zhes yod pa/ bsngo ba yon bshad mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba dgra rgyal chos kyi rgyal po yi/ /zhes yod pa/ bde mchog lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs ras pa shes rab 'od kyi don du mdzad pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde mchog 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /zhes yod pa/ rlung gi rten 'brel mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad la btud de/ / rlung gi rten 'brel zhes yod pa/ mnal lam tshigs bcad ma mgor/ skye ba skye ba med pa'i tshul rtogs kyang*/ /zhes yod pa/ dbang gi rgyal po'i sbyin sreg mgor gsum pa 'jug gi sbyin sreg bya ba'i zhes yod pa/ sme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs mgor na mo gu ru bhyaḥ khro bo stobs po che bsgrub par 'dod pas zhes bya ba yod pa/ lus kyi zag pa sbyin pa gtong ba'i gzungs mgor dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gong gi ming de nyid dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ rang gis rang la gros 'debs mgor yon tan rin chen dpal gyis lham me ba | | zhes yod pa/ dug bcos mgor oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyor ba dang po 'dis zhes pa dang*/

yang dug glo bur ba zhes pa gnyis/ sgra'i bstan bcos mkhas pa'i kha rgyan mgor oṃ swasti siddhaṃ dang*/ tshig de nyid yod pa/ legs bshad 'phrul gyi dra ba mgor bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad mkhyen pas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs zhes bya ba yod pa 'di the tshom can du bzhed pa yin no/ /zhar las sa skya paṇḍi ta'i rnam thar mkhas pa zhang rgyal ba dpal gyis mdzad pa'ang bris yod/ 'dir gsan yig na yod pa'i phyi mo ma rnyed pa ni brtag gnyis kyi sa bcad sna bsring ba/ thub pa'i bstod pa lhug pa/ gur ston zhus lan/ bka' gdams pa nam mkha' 'bum gyi dris lan mdor bsdus/ yan lag bdun ldan gyi rtsa ba rnams so// //lnga pa khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhal snga nas kyi gsung rab glegs bam dang po ( pa ) pa la shes bya rab tu gsal ba mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i phyag mchod mi 'phrogs ma/ rgyud 'grel gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs dang shes rab kun tu mnyam sbyor zhing*/ /zhes yod pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa ku mu ti dang bcas pa'i gsol 'debs gsungs pa 'di yin no/ / ba ri ba'i chos skor gyi brgyud 'debs mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /zhes yod pa/ 'jigs byed brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /zhes yod pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum saṃ skṛ ta'i skad can/ bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab byed spel ba mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spy-i bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal mchog sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ /ces yod pa/ yang gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab byed sku'i spyod pa la spel ba/

bla ma'i spyi'i bstod pa mu tig phreng ba mjug tu tshig de nyid yod pa/ chos rje pa la bstod pa gnyis mgor na maḥ shrī māṃ pa ra ma gu ru tsa ra ṇaṃ ka ma la sya banda naṃ ka ro mi/ blo chen ldan pa zhes dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi sngon du byang chub brnyes gyur kyang*/ /zhes yod pa/ chos spyod bcu pa cung zad rgyas par spel ba mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gang las srid dang rnam grol ba'i/ /zhes yod pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub gsan yig na gsol 'debs yan lag bdun pa gsungs pa 'di yin nam snyam/ chos spyod yan lag bcu pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo | | phyogs dus kun na bzhugs pa yi/ /zhes yod pa/ chos rje pa la bstod pa ri bo rtse lngar sbyar ba mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / tshogs gnyis tshogs ni rdzogs gyur cing*/ /zhes yod pa/ dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa mgor/ bsod nams chu gter dbus su legs 'khrungs shing*/ / zhes yod pa/ chos rje pa'i mtshan la spel ba'i bstod pa gnyis mgor 'gro kun gang la zhes pa dang*/ bde legs 'byung gnas zhes yod pa/ yang chos rje pa la bstod pa bzhi gang gi thugs zhes pa dang*/ bsod nams gser gyi zhes pa dang*/ mkhas pa'i tshogs kun zhes pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i snying po zhes yod pa/ thogs med sku mched sogs la bstod pa tshul khrims lhun po zhes yod pa/ yang chos rje pa la bstod pa gnyis mgor gdong bzhi thor tshugs zhes pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i chu 'dzin zhes yod pa/ thos pa rgya mtsho ma/ mchog brgyad kyi bstod pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhung lugs mi 'dra'i chu bo zhes yod pa/ bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa gang drin ma'i 'bru 'grel/ bla ma maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa sho dgon gyi slob dpon sbyong nga ba'i don du mdzad pa/

bla ma'i rnal 'byor la'o shu'i don du mdzad pa/ bla ma thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa phyogs bcu dus gsum ma dge slong gnas brtan byang chub bzang po'i don du mdzad pa/ chos rje pa'i rnam thar bsdus pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin kun nas rnam dag ces yod pa/ chos rje pa la rnam thar gyi sgo nas bstod pa me tog phreng ba mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya che zhes yod pa/ lam 'bras lam skor sogs kyi gsan yig mgor/ sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma la/ /zhes yod pa/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis zhus nas mtshal mdor bsdebs pa/ dpal kye rdo rje brtag pa gnyis pa'i bsdus pa'i don mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rgyud kyi mngon rtogs ljon chung mgor phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhes yod pa/ zhar byung maṅga la yab yum la gnang ba'i bkra shis/ ji big yab yum la gnang ba'i bkra shis/ /dpon mo chen mo la gnang ba'i bkra shis gsum yang bris 'dug

brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa dag ldan chung ba mgor dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud 'di 'chad par byed pa la zhes yod pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i spy-i don gsal ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi le'u'i 'brel mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i bsdus don mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ yig brgya bzla ba'i man ngag mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ bla ma maṇḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa'i man ngag mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma la zhes yod pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ kye'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs srung 'khor dang bcas pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam sbyor bde chen rtag pa'i sku/ /zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por yig brgya bzla ba'i tshul gnyis gsungs pa gcig 'di'i mgo na yod pa bgrang ba yin/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug chung mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi pa dang zhes yod la/ gsan yin dbang gi rgyal por bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi drug gi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gsungs pa'ang 'di yin no/ /bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad kyi zhus lan mgor dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad pas dri ba byed pa gang yin pa/ /zhes yod pa/ dam tshig gsum gyi glu'i rjes la bya ba'i smon lam mgor tshig de nyid kyi phyed yod pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por bdag 'jug dpal 'byung ma gsungs pa'ang 'di yin/ dbang gong ma gsum gyi lag len gyi rim pa tshigs bcad ma/ bdag 'jug gi cho ga snying po gsal ba mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/

khyab bdag gnyis med bde chen rtag pa'i sku/ /zhes yod pa | lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa blang ba'i lag len mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa zhes yod pa/ rgya mtshor go gon can gyi don du mdzad pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ kye'i rdo rje'i lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i lus sems gdod ma nas/ /zhes yod pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i bum pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i lung sbyor rdo rje gur nas phyung ba/ tshogs 'khor bsdus pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal las 'khrungs gyur pa'i/ /zhes yod pa | bdud rtsi'i 'byung ba mgor bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang zhes yod pa/ dpal rdo rje bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i bstod pa rnam dag gi phreng ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dag pa gsum gyi khrid yig mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam gyi sngon du 'gro ba zhes yod pa/ tshogs sbyor gyi mngon rtogs dbang gsum pa'i lam yang zer/ mgor tshig snga ma de nyid yod pa/ 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'pho ba'i rnal 'byor sgom par zhes yod pa/ khro bcu'i bstod bskul mgor dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' dbyings dag pa'i klong dkyil du/ /zhes yod pa/ seng ge mtha'i zhus lan rnam par nges pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi kun mkhyen yon tan rgya mtsho yi/ /zhes yod pa/ dbang phyug 'bum gyi dris lan tshigs bcad ma mgor rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba yod pa/ dus 'khor thugs dkyil gyi mngon rtogs mgor na mo gu ru kā la tsakrā ya zhes yod pa/

bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang gi sdom tshigs bcad ma mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs padma'i lte bar bzhugs/ /zhes yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi mngon par rtogs pa sgrub pa'i thabs kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi mchod pa'i kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i sbyin sreg gi sdom tshigs bcad ma mgor na maḥ shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra | nyon mongs bud shing kun bsregs shing*/ /zhes yod pa/ de'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyas pa mgor dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs nyung zhing gsal ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa rnams bzhugs so// //glegs bam gnyis pa/ ( pha ) pa la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub pa'i thabs rim pa gsal ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa mgor dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por ngag 'don gsungs pa 'di yin/ bde mchog gi rgyun bshags dpal nā ro pa las brgyud de 'ongs pa mgor bla ma dang bde mchog la phyag 'tshal rgya skad du yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi bstod bskul mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐ nga ni sku gsum mnyam sbyor zhing*/ /zhes yod pa/ dril bu pa'i dbang gi bya ba bsdus pa tshigs bcad ma mgor/ sku gsum ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /zhes yod pa/ lus dkyil gyi bdag 'jug mgor dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga zhes yod pa/

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rim pa lnga pa'i man ngag mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ yang de'i sgrub thabs jo sras phag mchu'i don du mdzad pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa zhes yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ 'di kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa la tshig rkang ma mnyam pa la sogs pa rnams kyi zhus dag dang kha skong mdzad pa yin/ yang jim gyim dang go go can la gnang ba'i bkra shis tshigs bcad mgor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog ces pa dang bla ma la na maḥ zhes yod pa/ phag mo lha so bdun ma'i mngon rtogs mgor rje btsun ma rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi mngon rtogs mgor dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes yod pa/ yang de'i sgrub thabs mgor rdo rje rnal 'byor mkha' spyod ma bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ de'i tshogs 'khor mgor dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes yod pa/ de'i sbyin sreg mgor dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes yod pa/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sdig sbyong gi cho ga mgor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sgo nas zhes yod pa/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rnam par rol pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/

yang de'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma hā mā yā bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs mgor rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa/ phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gi lha mo'i sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i lha mo bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ gur gyi rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa thang ngo ta'i don du mdzad pa yin/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i rim pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mgor ming de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du byas pa/ 'di 'phags pas mdzad pa min yang kha che'i paṇḍi ta ta thā ga ta bha dra dang 'phags pa rgya'i yul cong to mkhar du bsgyur ba yin/ gnas kyi dbang phyug ma'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ma/ /zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por oṃ ḍyan gyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs gsungs pa'ang de nyid yin no/ / 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ phyag drug sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ 'di sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rjes su 'brang ba yin/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang chog mgor rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga zhes yod pa/ mdor byas kyi sa bcad mgor 'di la gnyis te zhes yod pa | gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang chog mgor dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rab tu gsal ba zhes yod pa/
